name: deepl-mcp
description: DeepL local stdio MCP server (translation), API key passed through env from the OS keychain (Variant C)

token.title: DeepL API key
token.description: Create from your DeepL account's API keys page (API Free or Pro plan). Passed to the server as DEEPL_API_KEY through the environment — never as a CLI argument. Stored in the macOS Keychain.
